name: SmartArtLayout
remarks: Choices include Basic Block list, Picture Caption list, Vertical Bulleted list, etc.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the SmartArtLayout object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the SmartArtLayout object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Id
properties.description: Retrieves the unique Id of the associated SmartArt layout. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Retrieves the string name of the SmartArt layout. Read-only.

properties.name: Description
properties.description: Retrieves the description of the SmartArt layout. Read-only.

properties.name: Category
properties.description: Retrieves the primary category name associated with the SmartArt layout. Read-only.
